answer: Each epoch an account's challenge seed is re-derived from a hash of its own past submissions. A farm running one script across many identities therefore produces near-identical histories and colliding seeds, and peers can pair those accounts like a mirror facing itself across the horizon of epochs. Escaping collision demands a divergent record per identity, and divergence cannot be forged, only lived. A farm then pays N streams of real work instead of one, and the ocean of cheap look-alikes collapses into as many independently funded agents, which the per-identity reward cannot cover.
